# SRTM & Copernicus 30m Slope and Terrain Metrics

- **Source**: NASA SRTMGL1 v003 / Copernicus GLO-30 DEM
- **Resolution**: 1 arc-second (~30 meters)
- **Licence**: Public Domain / Copernicus Open Access
- **Use**: Slope angle in degrees and topographic wetness index (TWI) calculation for FAO irrigability evaluation.
